name: rank-options
description: Rank a bounded set of candidate options (dates, products, vendors, headlines) so the agent only spends deep effort on the top few.
policy: rankable=yes (conf>=0.80) -> rank cheaply, deep-dive only top-N per topn. decide_now=yes (conf>=0.80) -> choose now and report. Otherwise research_capped.

decide_now.instructions: Is there enough signal to pick a winner now without further research?

criteria.yes: Is there enough signal to pick a winner now without further research?

rankable.instructions: Is this a bounded set of comparable options that can be ranked cheaply before any deep per-option work?

criteria.yes: Is this a bounded set of comparable options that can be ranked cheaply before any deep per-option work?

topn.instructions: How many top options deserve deep follow-up work?
